title: Moses Returns with Aaron
reflectionText: Moses returned carrying a hard message, while Aaron was sent to meet him and help speak it before Israel’s elders. The people believed when they heard that Yahweh had seen their affliction. When a difficult calling must be faced, who has God placed beside you for the work?
editorialNotes: Packet 022 initial writer output. Short-only plan. The retelling stays within Exodus 4:18-31 and preserves Moses’s return, the lodging-place encounter, Aaron’s meeting, the signs, and Israel’s worship without resolving ambiguities the passage leaves unexplained.
